# Wayfinder

> Wayfinder is a local-first macOS and Windows desktop app that turns AI collaboration into a reviewable visual history of goals, attempts, branches, evidence, and outcomes.

Wayfinder is designed for AI-assisted research, writing, design, coding, and other project work. Codex and Claude Code are the current public Early Access collectors, not the product boundary.

The complete history stays on the user's computer under `~/.wayfinder`. The current product has no account, telemetry, cloud sync, or cloud analysis. Wayfinder does not invent missing historical file changes.

## Product

- [Wayfinder official website](https://wayfinder-ai.pages.dev/): Product overview and verified macOS and Windows downloads
- [What is AI collaboration history?](https://wayfinder-ai.pages.dev/ai-collaboration-history): Goals, attempts, branches, evidence, supported scenarios, and common questions
- [Data and privacy boundaries](https://wayfinder-ai.pages.dev/privacy): Local storage, collection, network access, and deletion

## Current Collectors

- [Codex session history](https://wayfinder-ai.pages.dev/integrations/codex): Local collection and evidence boundaries for Codex sessions
- [Claude Code session history](https://wayfinder-ai.pages.dev/integrations/claude-code): Local collection and project grouping for Claude Code sessions

## Source And Downloads

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/StayCurious-Xuan/wayfinder): Source code, README, issues, security policy, and public project history
- [Current Early Access release](https://github.com/StayCurious-Xuan/wayfinder/releases/tag/alpha-v0.3.16): Apple Silicon, Intel macOS, Windows x64, and checksums
- [Install guide](https://github.com/StayCurious-Xuan/wayfinder/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Platform-specific installation and first-run steps
- [Privacy policy](https://github.com/StayCurious-Xuan/wayfinder/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): Complete local-data contract

## Important Limits

- Wayfinder is currently distributed only as a desktop application.
- Plugins, VSIX packages, Skills, MCP bundles, CLIs, Homebrew, and Scoop are not current installation surfaces.
- File changes are created only from successful source tool calls with verifiable edit evidence.
